## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the current value. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move through the normal document focus order. |

## Accessibility

The root exposes switch semantics and keeps checked, disabled, and readonly states distinct.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/) for the host accessibility contract.
